item.title: Version 1.0.36
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.36

  • Fix: Memory leaks - Reuse GPU-backed CIContext for wallpaper blur instead of creating a new one per capture (~50-100MB each). Fix observer lifecycle leaks in ThemeManager and WallpaperBlurService. Convert CoreAudio device change listener to properly removable function pointer.
  • Fix: Bluetooth disconnect tracking - Prune stale entries from recently-disconnected device tracker to prevent unbounded dictionary growth.
  • Performance: Remove debug logging from Release builds - Replace 194 print() calls with logDebug() which is a no-op in Release builds, reducing string allocation and unified log pressure.

item.title: Version 1.0.35
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.35

  • Fix: Volume HUD not showing after connecting headphones - MediaKeyTapService now directly notifies the HUD after adjusting volume, bypassing CoreAudio listener dependencies. Fixes the issue where the volume HUD wouldn't appear after connecting Bluetooth or wired headphones.

item.title: Version 1.0.34
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.34

  • Wallpaper Blur — Dynamically blurs the desktop wallpaper when windows are focused. Each display blurs independently. Configurable intensity slider in Settings → Features → Desktop.

item.title: Version 1.0.33
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.33

  • Fix: Notch HUD position offset after sleep/unlock - HUD windows now restore to full-screen frames on wake, preventing the volume/brightness/media elements from appearing shifted to the right of the notch.
  • Fix: Media HUD persisting when nothing is playing - Auto-hide now defaults to on (5s), and a periodic staleness check force-hides the HUD if the media source has stopped. Fixes the issue where hovering over YouTube previews in Firefox caused the HUD to stick.
  • Custom color Apply button - Hex color inputs in Settings → Appearance → Custom Colors now show an explicit "Apply" button, so users don't need to press Enter to confirm typed values.

item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.32

  • Fix: Native volume/brightness HUD no longer appears on macOS 26 Tahoe - macOS 26 introduced BezelServices for system HUD overlays, which conflicted with Aegis's notch HUD (both would appear simultaneously). Aegis now intercepts media key events at the system level before BezelServices processes them, adjusting volume/brightness directly and showing only the Aegis HUD. Approach inspired by mew-notch.
  • Updated mediaremote-adapter to v0.7.6 - Fixes a slow memory leak in the Perl media monitoring process and improves compatibility with more apps.
  • Liquid Glass theme - New theme consistent with macOS 26 Tahoe's glass aesthetic, with configurable specular highlight and blur intensity.

item.title: Version 1.0.31
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.31

  • Fix: Menu bar stays hidden after screen lock/unlock in fullscreen - When macOS locked the screen while a fullscreen window was open, Aegis's menu bar would reappear on login instead of remaining hidden. The fullscreen state is now preserved across screen lock, unlock, and wake from sleep.

item.title: Version 1.0.30
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.30

  • Fix: "Send to Space" submenu now shows space numbers - The right-click context menu's Send to Space submenu was displaying "Space" for every entry without a number. Spaces are now correctly labelled "Space 1", "Space 2", etc.

item.title: Version 1.0.29
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.29

  • Space indicator scroll — Now Playing HUD overlap fix - The space indicator scroll area now dynamically adjusts its right boundary based on Now Playing HUD visibility. Pills stop before the album art panel when the media player HUD is open, and use the full width up to the notch edge when it is closed

item.title: Version 1.0.28
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.28

  • Crash Fix (macOS 26) — complete coverage - Extended the macOS 26 crash fix to all remaining windows: Settings panel, Yabai setup prompt, AeroSpace setup prompt, and App Switcher. All windows in Aegis are now fully protected against the macOS 26 constraint-update exception

item.title: Version 1.0.27
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.27

  • Crash Fix (macOS 26) — follow-up - A later macOS 26 beta renamed the internal method targeted by the v1.0.25 fix. Aegis now overrides both the public and private variants, covering all known macOS 26 beta builds

item.title: Version 1.0.26
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.26

  • AeroSpace Setup — Upgrade Fix - Integration scripts are now updated automatically from the app bundle when you open the setup prompt. Users upgrading from v1.0.23 who were missing the mode-notify script no longer need to manually re-run setup
  • AeroSpace Setup — Restore Fix - Deleting ~/.config/aegis and clicking Run Setup now correctly restores all three integration scripts in one step
  • AeroSpace Setup — "Check Again" Fix - The Check Again button in the setup prompt now always re-opens the setup window instead of silently closing it

item.title: Version 1.0.25
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.25

  • Crash Fix (macOS 26) — complete - Fixed the remaining crash on macOS 26 after granting permissions. The v1.0.24 fix only blocked one of two crash paths; this release adds an Objective-C exception guard directly in the window layer, catching all variants

item.title: Version 1.0.24
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.24

  • AeroSpace Mode Visualiser - Pill badge in the menu bar shows the active AeroSpace mode (e.g. RESIZE) when not in main mode, styled to match the space indicator. Disappears on return to main
  • AeroSpace Config Path - Installer now correctly detects ~/.config/aerospace/aerospace.toml alongside ~/.aerospace.toml
  • Crash Fix (macOS 26) - Fixed crash on launch after granting permissions on macOS 26

item.title: Version 1.0.23
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.23

  • AeroSpace Integration - Full workspace switching and window management via AeroSpace with instant FIFO pipe events (no polling)
  • Rift Integration - Window management via Rift Mach subscription API, auto-connects on launch
  • Multi-WM Auto-Detection - Aegis detects Yabai, AeroSpace, or Rift at startup — no configuration required
  • App Switcher by Workspace - Cmd+Tab replacement groups windows by virtual workspace for AeroSpace and Rift
  • WM-Aware Settings - Advanced tab shows correct integration info for the active window manager

item.title: Version 1.0.22
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.22

  • Wake with external monitor - Menu bar windows now correctly reposition after waking from sleep with an external monitor connected

item.title: Version 1.0.21
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.21

  • HUD Border - Configurable border outline on notch HUD panels (Settings > Notch HUD)
  • HUD Theme Colors - Custom theme colors now apply to HUD text, icons, and progress bars

item.title: Version 1.0.20
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.20

  • Fullscreen Fix - Menu bar now correctly hides in native fullscreen and reappears when leaving

item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.19

  • Custom Theme - New "Custom" theme option with hex color pickers for background, text/icons, and borders, plus saveable presets
  • CPU Optimization - Coalescing event gate reduces yabai subprocess calls from 7-13 to 2 per space switch; easeOut animations eliminate continuous 120fps rendering; non-reactive GeometryReader and Equatable icon isolation prevent unnecessary SwiftUI re-renders

item.title: Version 1.0.18
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.18

  • Auto-Expand Focused Window - Focused window's title is always displayed in the space indicator, animating smoothly as focus changes
  • Live Title Updates - Expanded title updates in real-time when browser tabs change or window titles update

item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.17

  • Space Drag-to-Reorder - Drag space indicators to rearrange workspaces with smooth spring animations
  • Window Drag Animations - Source icon collapses and target space glows when dragging windows between spaces
  • Multi-Monitor Fix - Space drag-to-reorder now works correctly on secondary displays
  • Accurate Drop Zones - Drop zone geometry uses actual measured widths for spaces of different sizes

item.title: Version 1.0.16
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.16

  • Fullscreen HUD Fix - Volume, brightness, and other HUD elements now appear on all spaces after exiting fullscreen apps
  • Focus Notification Suppression - Focus mode notifications no longer obscure the dedicated Focus HUD

item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.15

  • Stack Windows Menu - Full stack management from the right-click context menu with live yabai data
  • Minimized Window Indicators - Dimmed icons with yellow badge for minimized windows in stack menu
  • Stack/Unstack Individual Windows - Click to unstack, or stack minimized windows (auto-deminimize)
  • Theme System - Dark, Light, and System theme modes with consistent styling
  • Reliable Stacking - Fixed boot-out bug when adding windows to existing stacks

item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.14

  • Multi-Display Support - Menu bars now appear on all connected displays with configurable modes
  • Faster Monitor Detection - CoreGraphics callback for instant external display detection
  • Swipe-to-Destroy Fix - Space destruction gesture now works reliably on trackpad

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.13

  • Instant Yabai Updates - Menu bar now updates instantly on minimize, hide/unhide, and app launch/quit
  • Memory Leak Fixes - Fixed leaks in SystemInfoService, BluetoothDeviceService, and AegisConfig
  • Settings Panel - Restructured into 4 tabs with new context button toggle
  • Auto-Save Config - Settings now auto-save with debouncing
  • Date Format Fix - Date format toggle now works correctly

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.12

  • Multi-Space HUD Fix - Media HUD now appears on all spaces during video playback
  • Fullscreen Support - Added fullscreen auxiliary behavior for proper overlay support
  • Race Condition Fix - Fixed timing issues during fullscreen transitions

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.11

  • Memory Leak Fixes - Fixed icon cache, event monitor, and interaction monitor leaks that caused memory growth over time
  • System Status Toggle - New showSystemStatus config option to hide the system status panel
  • Performance - Space indicator hover now uses GPU-accelerated AppKit animation (reduced CPU usage)
  • Screen Unlock - HUD windows now properly reinitialize after login
  • Dynamic Title Updates - Expanded window titles now update when browser tabs change

item.title: Version 1.0.10
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.10

  • Screen Wake Fix - Media HUD now reappears after screen wake/unlock when music is playing
  • FaceTime Compatibility - Notch HUD now appears above FaceTime and other overlay windows

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.9

  • App Launcher Context Menu - Right-click the app launcher for a dropdown with all configured apps
  • Add/Remove Apps - Use "Add App..." to add applications via file picker, "Remove App" submenu to remove
  • Floating Apps - Apps launched from the app launcher now float and center on screen (50% size)

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.8

  • Window Drag Fix - Dragging a focused window to another space now works correctly
  • Context Button Animation - Space indicators and app launcher now animate when context button expands on scroll

item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.7

  • Notification Exclusions - New notificationExcludedApps config option to filter notifications from specific apps

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.6

  • HUD Overlay Fix - Fixed race condition where connecting AirPods could block other HUD elements from appearing

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.5

  • Memory Optimization - Album art scaled to display size, reduced cache (~50MB vs ~100MB)
  • Adaptive Frame Rate - 60fps→30fps→15fps based on animation progress
  • Background Decoding - Album art decoded off main thread for smoother UI
  • Fixed Alignment - Space indicators now vertically centered with notch
  • Yabai Setup Fix - Correct default config path (~/.config/yabai/yabairc)

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.4

  • Energy-Efficient Progress Bar - Replaced CVDisplayLink with lightweight DispatchSourceTimer
  • Lower CPU Usage - ~1-2% CPU during animation (down from 10-15%)
  • Zero Idle Power - Timer auto-stops when animation settles
  • Documentation - Updated architecture and guide for current implementation

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.3

  • Notification Click Uses Yabai - Click notification HUD to focus app window via Yabai (respects your window layout)
  • Media HUD Fix - Right panel (visualizer/track info) now shows correctly
  • Config Alias - showMediaHUD now works as config key (alias for showMusicHUD)
  • Code Consolidation - Shared HUD shapes, removed duplicate code

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.2

  • Context Button Scroll Option - New expandContextButtonOnScroll config to disable label expansion (saves CPU)
  • App Switcher Fix - Scroll momentum from menu bar no longer affects app switcher selection
  • Code Cleanup - Removed debug prints and unused code

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.1

  • Launcher App Exclusion - Apps in launcherApps config automatically hidden from space indicators
  • Better App Matching - Uses CFBundleName for accurate app name resolution (e.g., iTerm2)
  • Focus Highlight Fix - Launcher apps correctly highlight their space when focused
  • Finder Fix - Finder no longer incorrectly highlights space 1

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.0.0

  • App Launcher Button - New floating apps launcher in the menu bar with hover-reveal animation
  • Configurable Floating Apps - Customize floating apps via aegis.json config file
  • Auto-scroll for New Spaces - Menu bar scrolls to reveal newly created spaces behind the notch
  • Media HUD Rename - Music HUD renamed to Media HUD (backward compatible)
  • Bug Fixes - Empty space focus, space destruction behavior, menu bar flash, scroll animations
  • Performance - Reduced polling, removed duplicate monitoring code

item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.0

  • JSON Config File - Edit settings at ~/.config/aegis/config.json with hot-reload
  • Config Documentation - Auto-generated CONFIG_OPTIONS.md with all available settings
  • Space Indicator Sync Fix - Highlight now stays in sync with focus dot
  • Improved Event Handling - Force refresh for critical yabai events

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.7.0

  • Music HUD Track Info - Song title and artist with marquee scrolling for long text
  • App Switcher Scroll - Two-finger scroll to cycle through windows in Cmd+Tab
  • Cmd+Scroll Activation - Hold Cmd and scroll to open app switcher (opt-in)
  • Window Title Toggle - Right-click window icon to toggle title display (persists across focus changes)
  • Bluetooth Exclusions - Apple Watch excluded by default to prevent HUD on login

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.6.0

  • Bluetooth Device HUD - Shows device name, icon, and battery level when AirPods/headphones connect
  • Focus Mode HUD - Notch displays Focus mode name and icon when enabled/disabled
  • Scroll Fix - Space indicator scroll position no longer resets when switching spaces

item.title: Version 0.5.2
item.description:
What's New in 0.5.2

  • Setup Prompt - First launch shows setup window if yabai integration not configured
  • Settings Integration - "Yabai Integration" status button in Settings panel
  • No Sudo Required - Notify script moved to ~/.config/aegis/ (no admin privileges needed)
  • Cleaner Config - All Aegis files now in ~/.config/aegis/ for easy management

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
What's New in 0.5.1

  • Version Display Fix - Version numbers now display correctly across the app
  • Sparkle Window Fix - Update window now appears above the Settings panel
  • Build Improvement - Auto-sync version from VERSION file on build

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.5.0

  • Sparkle Auto-Updates - Built-in update checking with EdDSA signature verification
  • Check for Updates - New button in Settings > General to manually check for updates
  • Seamless Installation - Updates install automatically in-app

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
What's New in 0.4.0

  • Focus Mode Status - Display active macOS Focus mode in the system status bar with the actual custom icon from your Focus configuration
  • Optional Focus Name - Toggle to show Focus mode name alongside the icon
  • Critical Battery Indicator - Battery icon turns red when below 10%
  • Improved Battery Readability - Text shadow on battery percentage for better visibility
  • Smooth Animations - Focus icon slides in/out matching the NotchHUD animation style
